name: fuzzy-files
author: lumine-code
description: Quickly find and take an action over project files.

recentCount.title: Number of Recent Files
recentCount.description: How many recently used files to keep at the top of the list.

ignoredNames.title: Additional Ignored Names
ignoredNames.description: Files and directories matching these patterns are hidden from the finder and path suggestions. The editor's Ignored Names setting already narrows the shared project index; these patterns narrow this package's file list further.

separator.title: Type of separator in file paths
separator.description: Type of separator for the file path when copying or pasting.

pathCompletion.title: Path Completion
pathCompletion.description: Complete paths using the finder's project files and ignored names.

enabled.title: Enable Path Completion
enabled.description: Offer project file paths in autocomplete suggestions.

normalizeSlashes.title: Normalize Slashes
normalizeSlashes.description: Use forward slashes in inserted paths on every platform.

suggestionPriority.title: Suggestion Priority
suggestionPriority.description: Priority reported to the autocomplete service. Above the 2 a language server reports, so that an explicitly typed path outranks a general identifier list -- this provider only answers when a path prefix actually matched, so it never displaces anything otherwise.

imagePreview.title: Image Previews
imagePreview.description: Display image thumbnails in path suggestions.

scopes.title: Custom Scopes
scopes.description: Additional scope, prefix, and insertion replacement definitions over the same files the finder lists.

enableHtmlSupport.title: HTML Attribute Support
enableHtmlSupport.description: Suggest paths inside common HTML path attributes.
